scripture.verse: I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

sermons.title: Sermon 12 | The Peculiar Sleep of the Beloved

scripture.verse: For so he giveth his beloved sleep.

sermons.title: Sermon 13 | Consolation Proportionate to Spiritual Sufferings

scripture.verse: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world; and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
I have written to him the great things of my law; but they were counted as a strange thing.

sermons.title: Sermon 17 | Joseph Attacked by the Archers

scripture.verse: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him; but his bow abode in strength; and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel.
Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
